Package com.egradx.notification.web

Class EgradxNotificationExceptionHandler

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.core.web.EgradxExceptionHandlerSupport
com.egradx.notification.web.EgradxNotificationExceptionHandler
@Order(-2147483648) @RestControllerAdvice(assignableTypes={EgradxInboxController.class,EgradxNotificationPreferencesController.class,EgradxNotificationAdminController.class,EgradxNotificationPlatformAdminController.class}) public class EgradxNotificationExceptionHandler extends EgradxExceptionHandlerSupport
The notification endpoints' errors, in the envelope every EGRADX library answers with. The core exceptions and Spring's request errors are answered by EgradxExceptionHandlerSupport; notification's own are here. Scoped to this module's controllers, so it never answers for the host application's own.

Ordered first, as egradx-auth's and egradx-audit's are. Otherwise a host application's unscoped advice handling the same exception types wins or loses by registration order, and when it wins these endpoints answer in the application's envelope with its codes. OIM's parity check found this for a missing request parameter.
